= 2026-10-14 - First editor build
:page-audience: Developer

The first working build of Visual App Editor.

image::screenshot.png[Visual App Editor editing the sample project]

* Open any Flutter project folder; pages are found from widget classes with a `build` method.
* Widget tree, canvas with phone / tablet / desktop frames, properties, toolbox, pages, theme and toolkit panels.
* Toolbox entries generated by scanning package sources with `package:analyzer`; bundled manifests for core widgets, Material, Cupertino, shadcn_ui, forui, fluent_ui and macos_ui.
* Structural source edits (set / remove argument, insert, delete, wrap, reorder) that leave every other byte of the file untouched; edits that would not parse are refused.
* Code view with apply, undo / redo, Ctrl+S save.
* *Run* button: `flutter run` on the desktop device with hot reload on save.
* Project settings in `visual_app_editor.sdl`.
* Windows (Inno Setup), Linux (AppImage, .deb) and macOS (.dmg) packaging scripts, built in CI for Windows x64 / arm64, Linux x64 / arm64 and macOS arm64.
